component: About dialog shared and branded layout

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing centralizes client/left-box geometry in the shared About-dialog sheet and removes duplicate geometry from three branding sheets, which retain their logo images. The document loads the shared sheet before branding. Its initial670×400 minimum and 220px/1fr grid are historical declarations; accepted later flex/minimum rules differ. Neither the source nor a historical screenshot proves that every locale, font or native dialog size fits. No rendering test ran, and this is not a global grid or branding rule.
title: The About dialog resize port moves logo geometry into shared CSS while keeping branding images separate
